summary: Check rows.Err() before rows.Close() in novel-feature store loaders, and add a narrow documented #nosec G202 for SQLite VACUUM INTO.
reason: Six novel loaders closed *sql.Rows without checking rows.Err(), so a mid-iteration failure would surface as a complete result set — orphans could have reported live entities as orphaned. VACUUM INTO cannot be parameterized in SQLite; the path is program-derived and quote-escaped.
validated_outcome: gosec findings in hand-authored code went from 10 to 0; go test ./... still passes.
